- **Missing Shares:** 10 posts show "–" in Shares only. I counted them as 0, and their sums still match.

The report is at `results/2026-10-27/QA-29116-report.md`, with screenshots in `.playwright-out/QA-29116/`. I deleted the temporary credentials file I made for the login.
